The BFI-44 does not apply (different instrument). Sanity (not required for data_labels): in the local data.csv (0 set to NA) the - keyed C2/C4/C6/C8 correlate -0.26/-0.35/-0.31/-0.32 with C1 while + keyed C3/C5/C7/C9/C10 correlate +0.30..+0.43, so stored data are raw (unreversed) and the Disagree..Agree direction holds; per-item non-missing n = 19718 for all 10 items locally = live per-item n from irw_table_sets.
